name: Hashtag tag
summary: Pill chip reading #word that pops in with a slight wobble; for topic tags on short-form video.

params.name: word
params.note: word without the # (it is added); shrinks to fit

params.name: color
params.note: chip colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
